lines.text: In 1980, one tiny drilling mistake... swallowed an entire lake.

parts.tts: In nineteen eighty, one tiny drilling mistake...

lines.text: A Texaco rig was drilling for oil on Lake Pan-yur, Louisiana, right above a salt mine.

parts.tts: A Texaco rig was drilling for oil on Lake Pan-yur, Louisiana, right above a salt mine.
parts.heard: A Texaco rig was drilling for oil on Lake Pannier, Louisiana, right above a salt mine.

lines.text: At about 1,230 feet down, the drill punched into the mine.

parts.tts: At about one thousand two hundred thirty feet down, the drill punched into the mine.
parts.heard: At about 1,230 feet down, the drill punched into the mine.

lines.text: The lake started draining like a bathtub.

parts.tts: The lake started draining like a bathtub.
parts.heard: The lake started draining like a bathtub.

lines.text: The whirlpool swallowed the oil rig, eleven barges, a tugboat, and 65 acres of land.

parts.tts: The whirlpool swallowed the oil rig, eleven barges, a tugboat, and sixty-five acres of land.
parts.heard: The whirlpool swallowed the oil rig, 11 barges, a tugboat, and 65 acres of land.

lines.text: Then the canal reversed... The Gulf of Mexico flowed in backwards, creating Louisiana's tallest waterfall.

parts.tts: The Gulf of Mexico flowed in backwards, creating Louisiana's tallest waterfall.
parts.heard: The Gulf of Mexico flowed in backwards, creating Louisiana's tallest waterfall.

lines.text: Days later, nine of the sunken barges popped back up... like bath toys.

parts.tts: Days later, nine of the sunken barges popped back up...

lines.text: The lake went from 10 feet deep... to 200 feet of salt water.
